about.heading: About ITC Beautician Training & Service Center
about.introduction: ITC Beautician Training & Service Center is a registered beauty academy in Nepal dedicated to providing professional, practical, and career-oriented beautician education. Our goal is to make quality beauty training accessible and help students develop the confidence and skills needed to build successful careers in the beauty industry.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To offer high-quality beautician training that blends modern techniques with practical learning, enabling students to become confident professionals ready for salon work or independent practice.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To become a leading beauty academy in Nepal known for producing skilled beauticians, makeup artists, hair stylists, and beauty professionals.

trainer.name: Durga Aryal
trainer.title: Senior Beautician Trainer
trainer.subtitle: Beauty, Makeup, Hair & Nail Specialist
bio: Durga Aryal is a skilled beautician and trainer with extensive experience in makeup, hair styling, skin care, nail artistry, and salon services. Over the years, she has trained many students and helped them become confident beauticians.
She focuses on practical learning, proper technique, and helping students build the skills necessary for real-world beauty work.

philosophy.title: Teaching Philosophy
philosophy.quote: “Beauty skills grow through practice. I teach every student step-by-step, ensuring they understand each technique and can perform it confidently.”
